messages:
matt: kicking off v2026.3 rollout to EU-main now, canary 10% for 15m. watching p95 and 5xx dash https://dash.internal/redwood/slo/eu-main :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started: v2026.3 -> eu-main (canary=10%) | job=release-orch | id=dep-20260321-81 :robot_face:
sara: seeing p95 climb on /embed route in eu-west shard, from 180ms -> 340ms in last 5m, small bump in 5xx too :thinking_face:
alex: can we pause traffic shift if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms for 5m? that was our gate threshold earlier
jen: +1 to auto-pause. also recommend increasing sampling on traces for the canary so we get stack traces when it hits
matt: ok hold for 30s, i'll bump tracing sample to 20% and enable verbose logging for embed handler on canary nodes
oncall-bot: alert: eu-west /embed route 5xx rate 0.62% (threshold 0.5%) — triggered at 1818203778. incident link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-20260321-11 :rotating_light:
sara: paste PromQL I'm watching: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="embed",region="eu-west",status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="embed",region="eu-west"}[1m])) * 100
jen: logs from one canary pod: `2026-03-21T12:06:08Z ERROR embed_handler.go:115 context deadline exceeded` repeating a few times, looks like KV reads spiking
alex: sounds like regression from kvcache tuning in this branch — can we pin traffic back to v2026.2 for eu-west while leaving rest of region shifting?
matt: proposal: pause eu-west shift, pin eu-west to v2026.2, keep canary 10% in other regions. rollback plan ready if 5xx > 1.0% or error budget burn > 0.2 in 10m. anyone object? :eyes:
sara: agree, pin eu-west. i'll open a quick PR to pin routing rule and apply with small force flag
deploy-bot: traffic pin applied: eu-west -> v2026.2. change id=route-pin-743. canary remains 10% in eu-main
matt: thanks. jen can you follow up with a short postmortem note for the release notes about kvcache sensitivity? we'll want the avoid-list for next canary
jen: on it — will add short blurb and add the failing prompt set to the eval suite
oncall-bot: alert cleared: eu-west 5xx back to 0.18% at 1818203859. auto-note: incident auto-resolved after routing pin
matt: marking deploy as partial proceed but excluding eu-west. will resume after kvcache tweak rollout and a 1h soak. filing release note: "v2026.3 partial roll, eu-west pinned to v2026.2 due to embed 5xx spike; follow-up kvcache mitigation required." :memo:
alex: thanks everyone. re-open if we see any further blips. :thumbsup:
